STYLE.text: Modern high-budget 2D anime action. Multi-limb smears on fast strikes, sharp poses between them, one stylised impact flash. May not change: the order of events, who touches what, who is who.

LOOK.text: Dark, desaturated: charcoal, grey-blue, dark red carpet. Hard pale light from the windows on the left, deep shadows on the door side, slight bloom on the glass.

PACE.text: Full fighting speed, no slow motion, no pauses between strikes. Every block, duck and stumble happens at the instant of the hit, never a beat later. One pause, one second long, at the very end.

CAST.text: . Effort: strong, sudden, direct, bound: every strike is held tight and can stop dead. Body: drives from the hips, weight forward. Shape: tall and narrow, advancing. Face: eyes fixed on her target, never blinking.

. Effort: light, quick, evasive, free: he lets movement run on and carry him. Body: moves from the feet, weight on the back leg. Shape: crouched and turned side-on, retreating. Face: wide eyes, checking for exits. Exactly two people.

PHYSICS.text: The window wall is solid and takes a body hitting it. The handrail is screwed on: it tears free with a two-handed wrench, and snaps under a sharp downward blow when it is held at both ends. The doors are wood: a rail tip can lodge in one. Sneakers slide on the carpet. Neither fighter can lift the other. The rail reaches further than
is the heavier hitter: her kick moves
's whole body, while his blocks only turn her strikes aside. A body that is moving keeps moving until a wall or the carpet stops it. The rail needs both hands, and each thrust carries
half a step forward with it.

ANCHORS.text: 's three strikes in beat 1. Normal reach =

RULES.text: Contact: forearms, palms and crossed arms only; never clean on a face or body. Reaction: the body that is hit moves at the speed of the hit, at the same instant. Counts: three opening strikes, three rail thrusts, four strikes in beat 9, one flash. Range: every beat states the distance between them. It changes only through a step, a lunge or a blow that is shown. Inserts show a detail of the action in progress; they are never a new event. The fight continues during an insert; the next beat opens on the result.

END.text: 's face in both his hands, locked against the window light, half the rail still stuck in the door behind them. Nothing after.

SOUND.text: Rapid cloth snaps and forearm thuds in time with the strikes; a heavy impact on the kick and a thump against the wall; wood cracking as the rail tears free; two whooshes and a hard knock as the tip hits the door; one sharp crack as it snaps; the stub clattering away; a fast run of thuds; strained breathing. No music, no dialogue.

AVOID.text: the camera behind a fighter's back during punches, flat side-scrolling view, a long static ending, delayed reactions, bright even lighting, energy blasts, auras, extra people, slow motion, text, logos, watermark.

MOTION PRIORITY.text: For every beat, in this order: what each fighter is trying to do > the distance between them > stance > set-up > contact > reaction > recovery > camera readability.
